question: When were cigarette ads banned from tv uk?
text: Cigarette adverts were banned on UK television on **1 August 1965**. The ban did not initially cover cigars or loose tobacco, which could still be advertised on TV until the early 1990s. ([hansard.parliament.uk](https://hansard.parliament.uk/Commons/1965-03-02/debates/5a7e47fc-5584-49a9-84db-091679014ce1/CigaretteAdvertisements?utm_source=openai))
